climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A state with the oldest wine-making tradition in the United States. Friars planted the first wine grapes in 1629 in what is now the Middle Rio Grande Valley AVA. Its AVAs are Middle Rio Grande Valley, Mesilla Valley and Mimbres Valley.
